newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan June vehicle exports rise 31.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan June vehicle exports rise 31.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's vehicle exports in June rose 31.9 percent from a year earlier to 418,137 units, an automobile industry group said on Monday.
It was the 13th successive month in which exports rose on a year-on-year basis, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association (JAMA) said.
Japan's vehicle exports in the January-June period rose 20.6 percent from a year earlier to 2,179,593 units.

Exports to the United States rose in June for the tenth successive month. Exports to the European Union grew for the fourth straight month while exports to Asia rose for the third straight month, JAMA said.
Exports rose for the first time in the January-June period since the first half of 1992.
